metadata.title: RenOS: AI Agent Operating System for Teams | Vocom AI
metadata.description: RenOS is the AI system that runs your AI agents across any model, with policy routing, a plain-language reason for every choice, and an audit trail your admin can read. Start a pilot.

attributes.text: RenOS: The Operating System for Your AI Agents
Run AI agents across any model your team uses. RenOS decides which model handles each task under your rules, explains why in plain language, and writes an audit trail automatically.
Spend Less on Every AI Task

RenOS routes each task to the model that can do the job for the lowest cost, not whichever tool happens to be open. Teams on RenOS stop paying for five overlapping subscriptions and start paying only for the work that gets done.

Every task RenOS routes comes with a plain-language reason and a permanent record: who ran it, which model handled it, which policy applied, and what it cost. Nothing runs outside the record your admin can read.
Fast Draft Model · Support, Routine policy
Your Team Already Uses AI. Can You Prove What It Did?

Most teams now use five or more AI tools, each billed separately, none of the AI talking to each other, and nobody can show who ran what on which model with what data. RenOS puts one governed layer across all of it.
Type a request in Chat Mode, start a Builder task, or let an Agent pick it up. You never have to choose a model yourself.
RenOS checks your admin’s rules for the task type, the data involved, and your role, then picks the model before the task runs.
You see which model ran the task and a one-line reason why, in plain language, not a confidence score.
Every task, model, and decision is logged automatically, ready to export the moment compliance asks.
Ask a question or hand off a task. RenOS routes it to the right model and shows you why.
Run a task across more than one model side by side and compare the results before you commit.
Let agents work together on one task under your rules, with every handoff recorded.
AI Coaching Agents for Sales, Leadership and Frontline Teams

Coaching started as its own product, Vocom AI Coach Hub. It’s now built into RenOS as a set of coaching agents covering recruiting, sales, leadership and frontline teams, so coaching activity sits inside the same governed system as every other agent.
Scenario simulation and real-time feedback for pitch, negotiation and service conversations.
Simulated dialogue and 9-box reporting for succession and promotion readiness.
Guided coaching with progress tracking for onboarding, support and frontline service roles.
Hundreds of models behind one interface, so your team stops paying for five overlapping subscriptions.
RenOS does not belong to any model vendor, so it can route and log every one of them the same way.
One dashboard shows every session, model, and spend amount, by person or by team, without anyone having to ask.
Run RenOS inside your own environment as an add-on, so sensitive data never has to leave it.
Governance happens in the background. People submit a task in Chat, Builder, or Agent mode and just get their work done.
Agents escalate to your team the moment a task needs a person to step in.
Built for the Teams That Answer for Their AI
Different teams submit different work. RenOS applies the right policy to each one without anyone having to think about it.
Governed AI, Built Around Your Industry
RenOS adapts to the rules your industry already runs on, from data handling to who is allowed to approve what.
A 60-day design-partner pilot with a written success plan, run on one real workflow from your team.

attributes.$control__title: Talk to Us About a Pilot

attributes.$control__question: What is RenOS?
attributes.$control__answer: RenOS is Vocom AI's AI operating system for AI agents. It routes each task to the right model under your rules, explains the choice in plain language, and logs everything automatically.

attributes.$control__question: How is RenOS different from a single AI assistant?
attributes.$control__answer: A single assistant is tied to one model and one interface. RenOS sits above all of them, choosing the model per task and keeping one governed record across every tool your team uses.

attributes.$control__question: Which AI models does RenOS work with?
attributes.$control__answer: RenOS is designed to work across a wide range of models rather than lock you into one. Which models are enabled is set by your admin's policy.

attributes.$control__question: Where does our data go?
attributes.$control__answer: Routing decisions and task metadata are logged for your admin to review. Where the underlying task content goes depends on which model handles it and the deployment option you choose.

attributes.$control__question: Can RenOS run in our own environment?
attributes.$control__answer: Yes. A private deployment option is available so sensitive data stays inside your own environment.

attributes.$control__question: What happened to Vocom AI Coach Hub?
attributes.$control__answer: Coaching is now part of RenOS as coaching agents, covering sales, leadership and frontline skill building in the same platform.

attributes.$control__question: Will our existing systems work with RenOS?
attributes.$control__answer: RenOS is built to sit alongside the tools your team already uses rather than replace them. Talk to us about your specific systems during a pilot.

attributes.$control__question: How do we get started?
attributes.$control__answer: Start with a 60-day pilot on one real workflow, or book a live demo to see routing and the audit trail on a task of your own.
